properties.verseOrder: v1 c1 b1 e1 o1 o2 o3 o4

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Though I may not wear the garments of princes
You are my portion, You are my portion
For You clothe me in Your righteousness
You are my portion, You are my portion

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Though I may not sit at the table of kings
You are my portion, You are my portion
For You feed me from the abundance of Your hand
You are my portion, You are my portion

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
My everything, You meet my every need
You cover me and make me be at peace

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
You are my portion
You are my portion
You are my portion
You are my portion

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
My heart and flesh may fail
But You're the strength of my heart and my portion
You are my portion

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Father I will not worry about tomorrow or all of its questions
Father I will just trust you
And I will be waiting for treasures in heaven

verse.name: o2
verse.lines:
Say to the Lord:
"You are the Lord
And I have no good besides You"

verse.name: o3
verse.lines:
Father, I will not worry about tomorrow and all of its questions
Father, help me to trust you
And I will be waiting for treasures in heaven

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
My heart is with You
For there my treasure lies
My eyes are on You
For You are my delight

verse.name: o4
verse.lines:
Be my one portion
Be my one portion
